instances.claim: This tells me that Chang produced a bounded set of individual Cent objects, identical to one another when they were made, which have since been handled and aged differently.
instances.why: Line 19's "Each object, initially identical" and line 11's "Every Cent" both quantify over a collection with fixed membership, but the only set the draft ever introduces is the 500 billion circulating Lincoln cents of line 6 — a population Chang neither made nor made identical, and whose members the film never claims to have touched. Nothing in lines 1–18 establishes an edition of objects, so the comparative claim "initially identical" rests on a set that was never counted or bounded on screen.

instances.claim: This tells me that a particular object has already been put in view, and that it was in danger of ceasing to exist as a physical thing.
instances.why: "The object" is definite and "remained" is a continuation, so both point back for their referent and their threatened state; lines 1–3 supply only a value discrepancy and the cent's loss of purchasing power, which is a claim about worth, not about an object's persistence or disappearance. Taken together the two lines assert a survival that the draft never set up anything to survive.
